title: FileOutputStream 覆盖写迁成 fileIo 时，加 TRUNC 并按 writeSync 返回值写完

triggers.read: 源端 new FileOutputStream(file) 或 openOutputStream(uri) 加 OutputStream.write(data) 整文件写入
triggers.wrong: fileIo.openSync(path, OpenMode.WRITE_ONLY | OpenMode.CREATE) 没有 TRUNC，只调一次 writeSync 且不检查返回的字节数

scope: 把源端整文件覆盖写入迁成 @ohos.file.fs 时

how.text: 打开模式写 fileIo.OpenMode.WRITE_ONLY | fileIo.OpenMode.CREATE | fileIo.OpenMode.TRUNC
按 writeSync 的返回值循环写剩余部分直到写完，某次返回 0 时报错

values.meaning: 打开时把文件截成 0 长度

values.value: writeSync(fd: number, buffer: ArrayBuffer | string, options?: WriteOptions): number，返回实际写入的字节数
values.meaning: 写入可能不足量，要看返回值

values.value: FileOutputStream(File file) 等于 this(file, false)
values.meaning: 源端不追加，从文件开头覆盖写

values.value: 新增循环写、TRUNC 和精确切片后保留到最终
write(fd: number, buffer: ArrayBuffer | string, options?: WriteOptions): Promise<number>
values.meaning: 同族接口：异步写，同样返回写入字节数

values.value: writeSync(buffer: ArrayBuffer | string, options?: WriteOptions): number
values.meaning: 同族接口：Stream 和 RandomAccessFile 上的同步写

why: 不截断时新内容比旧文件短会留下旧尾巴，单次写不足量时文件不完整

probe.note: 打开模式只有 WRITE_ONLY | CREATE；若是覆盖写已有文件，要加 TRUNC

siblings_checked: 搜 buffer: ArrayBuffer | string：@ohos.file.fs.d.ts 里有 fileIo.write、fileIo.writeSync、RandomAccessFile.write/writeSync、Stream.write/writeSync 六个，fileIo.write 与 Stream.writeSync 写进 values

refs.quote: @returns { number } Length of the data written, in bytes.
declare function writeSync(fd: number, buffer: ArrayBuffer | string, options?: WriteOptions): number;
public FileOutputStream(File file) throws FileNotFoundException { this(file, false); }
declare function write(fd: number, buffer: ArrayBuffer | string, options?: WriteOptions): Promise<number>;
writeSync(buffer: ArrayBuffer | string, options?: WriteOptions): number;
